name: Spaceship 87759c78 on 4.8.8
description: A period-4 spaceship on the truncated square tiling 4.8.8 (touching neighbours), 14 to 17 cells, moving two lattice steps every 4 generations (c/2). It runs the same way in the 256 rules from B2/S2 to B2678/S245678; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Found by JETCARP's soup search (seen 2 times). A derivative ship (78d55497 with a tag-along): kept as a distinct object, not counted as a discovery.
